newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan firms to join consortium for CVRD bid.
newsitem.headline: Japan firms to join consortium for CVRD bid.

text.p: Twelve Japanese companies, including Nippon Steel Corp, have decided to join an international consortium to bid at the April 29 privatisation auction for Brazil's Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), Nippon Steel said on Monday.
The international consortium is the one formed by the Anglo American group of South Africa and Votorantim Group of Brazil, Nippon Steel said in a statement.
The 12 Japanese companies also include NKK Corp, Kawasaki Steel Corp, Sumitomo Metal Industries Ltd, Kobe Steel Ltd, Nisshin Steel Co Ltd and Nakayama Steel Works Ltd, it said.
The other five Japanese companies are all trading firms, it said.
The Japanese group will account for 10 percent of the investment in the consortium, Nippon Steel said, while the Anglo American group and Votorantim Group will account for more than 50 percent.
Nippon Steel said the consortium was holding talks with other parties about joining the consortium.
